description: Items 1-15 are follow-ups that only make sense after the `previous` question (pronouns and ellipsis); items 16-23 (kind: topic_change) are self-contained questions that follow an UNRELATED previous question, to check a resolver does not drag the old topic in. Used by conversation_eval.py to compare retrieval with the follow-up alone, with the old concatenation, and with the new resolver. 16 items, one document.
